info.title: LuraDB API
info.description: REST-native multi-model database — KeyValue- und JSON-Engine. `version` ist die API-Contract-Version (siehe API_VERSION), unabhängig von der Server-Version; letztere steht in der Extension `x-luradb-server-version`. Kompatibilitäts-Ranges: api/COMPATIBILITY.md. Laufzeit-Check: GET /version.

get.summary: `GET /health` — public heartbeat endpoint.
get.description: Returns a JSON snapshot of system vitals. No authentication required.

get.summary: Gibt alle angelegten User zurück (Admins und reguläre User).
get.description: API Keys werden nicht ausgegeben — nur Name, Rolle und Erstellungszeitpunkt.

post.summary: Legt einen neuen User mit der Rolle `User` an.
post.description:
Der API Key wird **ausschließlich in dieser Response** zurückgegeben und danach nicht mehr gespeichert.
Nur Admins dürfen diesen Endpunkt aufrufen.

201.description: User angelegt. API Key einmalig in der Response.

delete.summary: Löscht einen User und alle seine Domain-Permissions.
delete.description: Der API Key des Users wird sofort ungültig — laufende Requests mit dem alten Key erhalten danach `401`.

post.summary: Setzt oder überschreibt die Zugriffsberechtigung eines Users auf eine Domain.
post.description:
`access` muss `"read"`, `"write"` oder `"ddl"` sein — jede Stufe schließt die
niedrigeren ein. Für `kv` muss die Domain existieren; `json`/`rel` prüfen nur den Namen.

delete.summary: Entzieht einem User die Zugriffsberechtigung auf eine bestimmte Domain.
delete.description:
`?store_type=json`/`rel` entzieht eine JSON-/rel-Domain-Permission (Default: kv).
Nach diesem Aufruf erhalten Requests des Users auf diese Domain `403 Forbidden`.

post.summary: Generiert einen neuen API Key für den User und invalidiert den alten sofort.
post.description:
Der neue Key wird **ausschließlich in dieser Response** zurückgegeben.
Verwende dies bei Key-Leaks oder regelmäßiger Key-Rotation.

get.summary: Returns all active domains with their names and creation timestamps.

post.summary: Creates a new logical domain (isolated KV namespace).
post.description: Domain names must be unique, max 50 chars, and match `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]`.

get.summary: Returns metadata for a single domain by name. Returns 404 if it does not exist.

delete.summary: Schedules a domain and all its data for deletion.
delete.description: The domain becomes immediately inaccessible; the actual purge runs in the background.

get.summary: Returns all active JSON domains.

post.summary: Creates a new JSON domain (isolated document namespace, separate from KV domains).

get.summary: Returns metadata for a single JSON domain, including its document count.
get.description: Domains in `deleting` state answer with 410 Gone.

410.description: Domain is being deleted (background purge running)

delete.summary: Marks a JSON domain as deleting. Documents become inaccessible immediately.

post.summary: Imports documents from an NDJSON body in atomic batches.

requestBody.description: NDJSON — one document per line, optional _key field

get.summary: Lists documents of a domain without filters (natural key order).

post.summary: Stores a document under a system-generated UUIDv4 key (create-only).

201.description: Document created with generated UUIDv4 key

get.summary: Counts all documents of a domain (key scan only).
Reads a document; `_key`/`_version` are top-level fields and an opaque

put.summary: Upserts a document. With an `If-Match: "<etag>"` header the write is a
put.description: conditional update that fails with 409 on a version mismatch.

404.description: Domain not found, or If-Match on missing document

delete.summary: Deletes a document and its index entries. Supports conditional delete via

get.summary: Streams all documents of a domain as NDJSON without full buffering.
Lists all index definitions of a domain.

post.summary: Creates an index definition. Existing documents are NOT back-indexed —
Starts a background re-index of the domain (all indexes, or one field).

409.description: Re-index already running for this domain

get.summary: Returns the status of a re-index task. Tasks are domain-scoped: a task id

404.description: Unknown task id for this domain

post.summary: Searches documents via indexed fields. Filters: `"field": value` for
post.description: equality or `"field": {"$gt": …}` for ranges; multiple fields are ANDed.

get.summary: Lists all keys in the domain, optionally filtered by a prefix. Returns an empty array if no keys match.
Retrieves the raw byte value for a key. Returns 404 if the key does not exist or has expired.

put.summary: Inserts or updates a value for the given key (upsert semantics).
put.description: The optional `ttl` query parameter sets an expiry in seconds; omitting it stores the key indefinitely.

delete.summary: Permanently removes a key from the domain. The operation is idempotent; deleting a non-existent key still returns 204.

patch.summary: Writes an explicit null/tombstone marker for a key without removing it from the keyspace.
patch.description: Useful for signalling soft-deletes in distributed or CDC scenarios.

get.summary: Opens a Server-Sent Events stream that delivers real-time change events (`set` / `delete`) for keys matching the optional prefix.
get.description: The connection stays open until the client disconnects; a keep-alive ping is sent automatically.

200.description: SSE stream of key change events

get.summary: `GET /metrics` — system + all domain metrics. Admin only.
`GET /metrics/domains/{name}` — metrics for one domain. Admin or domain user.

404.description: Domain not found or no metrics yet

get.summary: Returns all active relational domains.

post.summary: Creates a new relational domain (isolated table/view namespace, separate

get.summary: Returns metadata for a single relational domain. A domain in `deleting`
get.description: state answers 410 Gone (rel/013 finishes the physical purge).

410.description: Domain is being deleted (background purge running)

delete.summary: Marks a relational domain as deleting. Its tables/views become
delete.description: inaccessible immediately; physical cleanup follows in rel/013.

post.summary: Executes exactly one LuraSQL statement against `domain` and returns its
post.description:
typed result. `expand` resolves REFERENCES columns of a SELECT into
embedded objects (or `"*"` for every REFERENCES column).

200.description: Statement result. Shape depends on the statement class — DDL: {"ok":true}; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE: {"affected","last_pk"}; SELECT: {"columns":[{"name","type"}],"rows":[[...]],"row_count","limit_applied","expanded"?}. `rows` are arrays (not objects) so same-named JOIN columns don't collide.

400.description: Syntax, type, parameter-count, or expand error

403.description: Access level too low for this statement (rel/011)

404.description: Domain, table, column, or index not found

409.description: Conflict — duplicate key, unique violation, name collision, …

get.summary: Lists the tables of a domain (views are listed separately, `GET …/views`).
Returns a table's schema (columns, indexes) plus HATEOAS links. A view
get.description: name answers 404 here — use `GET …/views` for views.

404.description: Domain or table not found (a view is not a table)

get.summary: Lists rows of `table`. Every query parameter other than `expand`/`limit`/
get.description:
`offset` is an equality filter on the like-named column (`?col=value`,
AND-combined); parse errors and unknown filter columns answer 400. This
compiles onto the same bound `*`-SELECT plan `/sql` would use.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated REFERENCES columns to resolve, or "*" for all

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows to return (falls back to the configured default, capped at the configured max)

200.description: Matching rows as objects, with row_count/limit/offset/limit_applied

400.description: Unknown filter column, or a filter/limit/offset parse/type error

post.summary: Inserts one row from a JSON object body (`{column: value, …}`). An omitted
post.description:
AUTOINCREMENT primary key is assigned the next sequence value (rel/005
§9); this compiles onto the exact same bound INSERT plan `/sql` would use.

404.description: Domain, table, or referenced body column not found

409.description: PK collision, unique violation, or missing REFERENCES target

get.summary: Fetches a single row by primary key — the same PK-point SELECT plan

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated REFERENCES columns to resolve, or "*"

200.description: The row as an object, with an optional _expanded block

404.description: Domain, table, or row not found

put.summary: Partially updates a row by primary key: only the columns named in the
put.description:
body are set, everything else stays unchanged (spec §5). Not an upsert —
a PK the table doesn't have answers 404, never a create.

400.description: NOT NULL/type/schema violation, or body primary key != path primary key

404.description: Domain, table, column, or row not found

409.description: Unique violation, or missing REFERENCES target

delete.summary: Deletes a row by primary key. Hanging REFERENCES from other tables are
delete.description: not blocked by this (rel/005 §11) — they resolve to `null` afterwards.

404.description: Domain, table, or row not found

get.summary: Lists the views of a domain, including their raw (unmodified) SQL text.

200.description: Views of the domain, incl. raw SQL text

get.summary: `GET /version` — version handshake. Requires any valid API key.

key.description: Document key or "line N" for parse errors.

field.description: JSON field path, dot notation for nested fields (e.g. "address.city").

api_key.description: API Key (nur einmalig sichtbar — danach nicht mehr abrufbar).

document_count.description: Number of documents — only set on the detail endpoint.

field.description: Optional: re-index only this field's index. Omit for all indexes.

state.description:
Lifecycle state: "active" or "deleting" (background purge running, rel/013).
Always present — so rel/013's later `list_domains` visibility change
(surfacing `Deleting` domains too) needs no REST-contract change.

api_key.description: Neuer API Key (nur einmalig sichtbar — danach nicht mehr abrufbar).

rows.description:
One JSON object per row (catalog column order in principle; `serde_json`'s
default map is unordered/alphabetical here, see rel_browse.rs module docs),
with an optional `_expanded` block (spec §6).

store_type.description: Store-Typ der Domain: `"kv"` (Default), `"json"` (spec json/012) oder `"rel"` (spec rel/011).

expand.description:
REFERENCES columns to resolve into embedded objects, or `["*"]` for
all of them (§5). Only valid for SELECT; non-empty on DML/DDL → 400.

params.description:
Positional parameters (JSON array), bound to the `?` placeholders
(rel/004/005). Omitted ⇒ empty array.

bearer_auth.description: API Key wie in `luradb.toml` konfiguriert (Admins) oder wie bei User-Anlage / Key-Rotation erhalten. Nur bei `auth.enabled = true` erforderlich.
